message.content:
✅ 补丁已提交并通过编译验证（`verificationStatus: passed`，0 错误 0 警告）。

**修改内容**（results.tex 第一段）：

| 原文 | 修改后 |
|---|---|
| `In this study, we report that accuracy is 91.2\% on 12 samples.` | `Accuracy is 91.2\% on 12 samples.` |

第二句 `We do not claim statistical significance~\cite{smith2024}.` 完全未动。请在内联 diff 预览中确认后接受即可。

patch.title: 删除 results.tex 第一段开头的 "In this study, we report that "，并将 "accuracy" 改为大写 "Accuracy"，其余内容原样保留

hunks.oldText: In this study, we report that accuracy is 91.2\% on 12 samples. We do not claim statistical significance~\cite{smith2024}.
hunks.newText: Accuracy is 91.2\% on 12 samples. We do not claim statistical significance~\cite{smith2024}.
